picks.excerpt: Snap says its Specs AR glasses, launching this fall, ship with a cross-platform AI agent and an optional cellular charging case — pushing agent UI onto the face.
picks.rationale: First shipping consumer AR glasses with a cross-platform agent — the agent-on-your-face interface moves from concept deck to a surface designers must actually spec.

picks.excerpt: A design proposal for 'AI nutrition facts' — an interface layer between writers, readers and AI that discloses how much of a piece was machine-generated.
picks.rationale: AI 생성 비율을 인터페이스로 드러내자는 제안 — 디자이너가 화면에 설계해야 할 새 공시 레이어.

picks.excerpt: From luxury watches to GPU cold plates, product teams are replacing slow solvers with AI surrogate models — and finding where the cost-benefit tradeoff actually holds up.
picks.rationale: Named shipping products, not a demo: shows exactly where AI surrogate models pay off in a real design loop and where they still do not.

picks.excerpt: Autodesk's own AI-made short film shipped with a continuity error no prompt could fix. VP of M&E strategy Maurice Patel explains why AI won't replace human animators.
picks.rationale: A concrete failure mode from the vendor's own showcase — names the exact class of continuity work generative pipelines still cannot close.

picks.excerpt: Designer Jesse Showalter puts Framer's agent to work fixing bugs in a live site build — a short, concrete look at agentic editing inside a mainstream design tool.
picks.rationale: Agentic editing inside Framer, watched end to end on a real site — the most directly copyable workflow in the pool for a working designer.
